name: Web & digital experiences
headline: A digital presence that earns a closer look.
description: Clear, responsive websites and useful interfaces built around what your customers need to do.
fit: For businesses whose website no longer reflects their capabilities, or whose customers need a simpler digital journey.
inputs: Your audience, current site, brand assets, content and the action visitors should take.
steps: Map the audience, page hierarchy and key journeys.
Prototype the important screens and review content together.
Build, check accessibility and responsive behavior, then prepare handoff.

name: Data, MIS & automation
headline: Make your data easier to act on.
description: Reporting, dashboards and connected workflows that help your team understand the business and reduce repetitive work.
fit: For teams working across disconnected spreadsheets, recurring reports or manual handoffs that need a dependable process.
inputs: The decisions you need to make, your reporting process and a sanitized sample of the source structure. Do not send private datasets through the inquiry form.
steps: Define the decisions, measures and data permissions.
Model the data and prototype reports with representative samples.
Validate calculations, document refresh steps and agree access controls.

name: Design & creative
headline: Clarity, with a distinctive point of view.
description: Visual identities and communication assets that make a business recognizable across the places its audience sees it.
fit: For businesses building a consistent identity, presenting a new offer or making fragmented communications feel connected.
inputs: Your existing identity, audience, approved copy, required formats and examples of what is and is not working.
steps: Clarify the communication problem and visual direction.
Develop a system through a small set of representative applications.
Refine the artwork and supply organized, usable export files.
